name: Banana Battalion
card_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
card_desc: → Battalion was made just for people like you. Reaching for top 100 in a competitive environment without the pressure of an elite team. Compete, grow, move up when you're ready.
modal_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
modal_desc: Banana Battalion is a development CT squad that takes competition seriously without the extreme demands of an elite team. It's a great home for players who are actively improving and want to prove themselves in a competitive environment. Think of it as another path toward the top — you compete, you grow, and when you're ready, you move up.
requirements: Regular ticket usage — you're expected to participate meaningfully each event
Willingness to learn — open to feedback and strategy from more experienced players
Decent scoring — contributing to team placement, not just showing up
Discord presence — staying in the loop on plans and coordination
Competitive mindset — you want to improve, not just coast
